title: equisetum ramosissimum var. dregeanum
intro: Equisetum ramosissimum var. dregeanum, commonly known as Cape horsetail, is a type of vascular plant that belongs to the family Equisetaceae, characterized by its unique jointed stems and whorls of leaves. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of urinary disorders, kidney stones, and inflammatory conditions due to its diuretic and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Cape horsetail include its ability to promote urine production, reduce inflammation, and act as a natural antiseptic. Bioactive constituents of Cape horsetail include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
